context: Yuki has come by to help her friend's dad Ryosuke set up a new printer at home.
purpose: cross-generation tech help — younger person guiding older with patience and respect

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ゆきさん、ほんとに助かるよ。
lines.style: Father warm grateful greeting, the older man's tech-helplessness humbly acknowledged, real appreciation threading throughout warmly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いえいえ、簡単ですから大丈夫です。
lines.en: Not at all, it's easy so no worries.
lines.style: Office woman bright reassurance, the gentle confidence carrying through, soft real warmth toward the older man throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: パソコンってさ、毎年難しくなる気がするよ。
lines.en: Computers — I swear they get harder every year.
lines.style: Father wry self-aware complaint, the generational humor audible, soft real frustration mixed with humility throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: わかります。慣れですよ、きっと。
lines.en: I understand. It's a matter of getting used to it.
lines.style: Office woman warm sympathetic explaining, the patient teaching cadence opening up, soft real respect maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: この設定、自分でやろうとして失敗した。
lines.en: This setup — I tried doing it myself and failed.
lines.style: Father honest admission with self-deprecating warmth, the failure shared without ego, soft real humility throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あ、ここをクリックすれば、自動でできますよ。
lines.en: Ah, if you click here, it goes automatic.
lines.style: Office woman gentle teaching pivot, the patient pointing-and-showing energy, real care for the older man throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ほう、なるほど。これは便利だ。
lines.en: Oh, I see. This is convenient.
lines.style: Father warm impressed appreciation, the real learning landing audibly, soft genuine recognition threading through delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: これで完了です。お疲れさまでした。
lines.en: That's it, all done. Good work.
lines.style: Office woman warm closing brightness, the friendly professionalism softened by personal connection, sincere warmth throughout.
